## Motivation

Fixes #47759

At `--log-requests-level` 0/1, the request log is supposed to exclude input/output (`text`, `input_ids`, ...). However, some fields still carry it into the log:

- `video_config._question` — the OpenAI chat entrypoint copies the user's video-paired question text into it (`_build_video_config` in `serving_chat.py`, introduced by #33829); the DotsNote-Omni processor consumes it. This is triggered in the majority of video scenarios.
- `images_config.prefix` — Unlimited-OCR convention where the user's task prompt is sent inside `images_config` in the request body; the processor appends it after the image tokens

The skip-name mechanism only matches top-level field names, so nested fields cannot be skipped directly — this requires multi-level skip logic. Without it, user input data leaked into logs even at the "metadata only" level 0.

There are some other fields populated only for specific inputs may also carry input/output (e.g Output side (`meta_info`): `logprobs` (`return_logprob`=True), `prompt_token_ids` (`return_prompt_token_ids`=True)). They are **out of scope** for this PR.

## Modifications

- `skip_names` now supports dotted entries (`"parent.child"`, any depth) that skip nested fields.
- New `_child_skip_names()`: strips the current key's prefix from the skip set when recursing into a child, so skipping propagates down the tree in both serializers.
- Level 0 and level 1 skip sets add `video_config._question` and `images_config.prefix`.

Compatibility:
- Levels 2/3: unchanged (no skip names).
- OpenAI raw payload logging: unchanged (gated at level >= 2).

No docs change needed: the per-level description of `--log-requests-level` stays accurate.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable (logging-only change).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable (logging-only change).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

     return value
 
 
+def _child_skip_names(skip_names: Optional[Set[str]], key: Any) -> Optional[Set[str]]:
+    """Return the skip entries scoped to `key`'s subtree with the `key.`
+    prefix stripped, so nested fields can be skipped via dotted names
+    (e.g. "video_config._question"). Bare entries only match at the
+    level where they are named. None when the subtree has nothing to
+    skip."""
+    if not skip_names or not isinstance(key, str):
+        return None
+    prefix = key + "."
+    children = {
+        entry[len(prefix) :] for entry in skip_names if entry.startswith(prefix)
+    }
+    return children or None
+

+import json
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import GenerateReqInput
+from sglang.srt.utils.request_logger import (
+    RequestLogger,
+    _dataclass_to_string_truncated,
+    _transform_data_for_logging,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_LOGGER = "sglang.srt.utils.request_logger.stdout"
+_SECRETS = (
+    "SECRET-QUESTION",
+    "SECRET-PREFIX",
+    "SECRET-TEXT",
+    "SECRET-CUSTOM",
+)
+
+
+def _make_obj() -> GenerateReqInput:
+    return GenerateReqInput(
+        text="SECRET-TEXT",
+        input_ids=[1, 2, 3],
+        video_data="SECRET-VIDEO",
+        video_config={
+            "_question": "SECRET-QUESTION",
+            "lora_path": "lora-x",
+            "fps": 16,
+            "max_frames": 8,
+        },
+        images_config={"prefix": "SECRET-PREFIX", "image_mode": "auto"},
+        sampling_params={
+            "max_new_tokens": 4,
+            "custom_params": {"text": "SECRET-CUSTOM"},
+        },
+    )
+
+
+class TestNestedSkipEntries(CustomTestCase):
+    """Dotted skip entries hide nested fields at levels 0/1 while
+    same-named fields elsewhere (and levels 2/3) stay intact."""
+
+    def _received_log(self, level: int, fmt: str) -> str:
+        log = RequestLogger(
+            log_requests=True,
+            log_requests_level=level,
+            log_requests_format=fmt,
+            log_requests_target=None,
+        )
+        with self.assertLogs(_LOGGER, level="INFO") as cm:
+            log.log_received_request(_make_obj())
+        self.assertEqual(len(cm.records), 1)
+        return cm.records[0].getMessage()
+
+    def _received_obj_json(self, level: int) -> dict:
+        return json.loads(self._received_log(level, "json"))["obj"]
+
+    def test_level0_json_hides_nested_fields(self):
+        msg = self._received_log(0, "json")
+        obj = json.loads(msg)["obj"]
+        # Bare "lora_path" only skips the top-level field.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            obj["video_config"], {"lora_path": "lora-x", "fps": 16, "max_frames": 8}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(obj["images_config"], {"image_mode": "auto"})
+        self.assertNotIn("sampling_params", obj)
+        for secret in _SECRETS:
+            self.assertNotIn(secret, msg)
+
+    def test_level0_text_hides_nested_fields(self):
+        msg = self._received_log(0, "text")
+        self.assertIn("'fps': 16", msg)
+        self.assertIn("'image_mode': 'auto'", msg)
+        for secret in _SECRETS:
+            self.assertNotIn(secret, msg)
+
+    def test_level1_json_hides_nested_fields(self):
+        msg = self._received_log(1, "json")
+        obj = json.loads(msg)["obj"]
+        self.assertEqual(
+            obj["video_config"], {"lora_path": "lora-x", "fps": 16, "max_frames": 8}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(obj["images_config"], {"image_mode": "auto"})
+        # Bare top-level names must not skip same-named nested keys.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            obj["sampling_params"]["custom_params"], {"text": "SECRET-CUSTOM"}
+        )
+        for secret in ("SECRET-QUESTION", "SECRET-PREFIX", "SECRET-TEXT"):
+            self.assertNotIn(secret, msg)
+
+    def test_level2_and_level3_keep_nested_fields(self):
+        for level in (2, 3):
+            with self.subTest(level=level):
+                obj = self._received_obj_json(level)
+                self.assertEqual(obj["video_config"]["_question"], "SECRET-QUESTION")
+                self.assertEqual(obj["images_config"]["prefix"], "SECRET-PREFIX")
+                self.assertEqual(obj["text"], "SECRET-TEXT")
+
+    def test_dotted_skip_propagates_to_depth_three(self):
+        data = {"a": {"b": {"c": "SECRET-DEEP", "d": 1}}}
+        out = _transform_data_for_logging(data, 2048, {"a.b.c"})
+        self.assertEqual(out, {"a": {"b": {"d": 1}}})
+
+    def test_bare_skip_does_not_reach_nested(self):
+        out = _transform_data_for_logging(
+            {"text": "DROP", "outer": {"text": "KEEP"}}, 2048, {"text"}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(out, {"outer": {"text": "KEEP"}})
+
+    def test_two_arg_calls_unchanged(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _transform_data_for_logging({"a": {"b": 1}}, 2048), {"a": {"b": 1}}
+        )
+        s = _dataclass_to_string_truncated(_make_obj(), 2048)
+        self.assertIn("'_question': 'SECRET-QUESTION'", s)
+        self.assertIn("'fps': 16", s)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
